topic: 5 free AI tools that replaced paid apps
angle: Every one of these has a paid equivalent people are still paying for
hook: 5 free AI tools that replaced my paid apps
caption:
I cancelled four subscriptions this month. Not because money got tight — because the free version got better than what I was paying for. These five are the ones that actually stuck after a full month of daily use, not the ones that looked good in a demo.

💬 Comment "STACK" and I'll send you the full list.
🔖 Save this for the next time you need it.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#aitools #freetools #productivity #chatgpt #claudeai #techtips

slides.text: 5 free AI tools that replaced my *paid* apps
slides.subline: All five have a subscription equivalent

slides.text: Everyone keeps paying for tools that shipped a free tier six months ago. Nobody goes back to check.

slides.title: Check before you renew
slides.body: Open every subscription you pay for and search the tool name plus free tier. Half of them shipped one this year to compete. You are paying for the version you signed up to, not the version that exists.

slides.caption: cancelled in one month without losing a single workflow

slides.title: Replace one at a time
slides.body: Swapping your whole stack in one weekend fails. Pick the subscription you use least, replace it, wait a week. If nothing broke, cancel it and move to the next one.

slides.text: Save this before you need it
slides.subline: Send it to someone still paying for this
